    """Cheapest service by cost; ties go to the name that sorts first."""
    available = quotes(parcel)
    if not available:
        return {"id": parcel["id"], "status": "unavailable",
                "reason": "no service covers zone %r" % parcel["zone"]}
    best = min(available, key=lambda q: (q["cost"], q["service"]))
    return {"id": parcel["id"], "status": "selected", **best}


def select_all(parcels):
    return {"parcels": [select_cheapest(p) for p in parcels]}
